acceptance_criteria: `pub struct Axis { pub origin: Point3, pub dir: [f64; 3] }` and `Kernel::revolve(&self, face: &Self::Shape, axis: Axis, angle: f64) -> Result<Self::Shape, KernelError>`, documented, implemented for `OcctKernel`. The direction is normalized before use; a positive angle turns counterclockwise looking down `dir` (right-hand rule).

`pub fn revolve_feature<K: Kernel>(k: &K, face: &K::Shape, axis: Axis, angle: f64, mode: ExtrudeMode, target: Option<&K::Shape>) -> Result<K::Shape, KernelError>`, documented. It follows `extrude_feature`'s rules: `NewSolid` ignores `target`; the other modes need one (`InvalidInput`); a result volume below `EMPTY_VOLUME_TOLERANCE` is `EmptyResult`. Shared logic is factored, not copied.

Tests (behind `occt`) use a profile made with `make_face` on the workplane `origin (0, 0, 0)`, `x_dir (1, 0, 0)`, `normal (0, −1, 0)`, so that u is x and v is z. The axis is the z axis through the origin. Volumes within a relative 1e-6, boxes within 1e-6: Full turn, Quarter turn, Revolve cut, Revolve join.

Errors, each with a test and never a panic: angle ≤ 0, angle > 2π (allow 2π within 1e-12), a non-finite angle, a zero-length or non-finite axis direction, a non-finite axis origin: all `InvalidInput`, checked before anything reaches OCCT.
No new dependencies. `swx-kernel` still has no workspace dependencies. Every new shim function is `noexcept` and catches C++ exceptions; every new `unsafe` block is in `ffi` and documented.
`cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace` pass, and so do the CI `swx-kernel (occt)` job commands.
QA report (FACTORY §6b) posted on the PR.
